CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_CUS__JobConsolidationExtended] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT [CarrierAddressKey] = [CarrierAddress].[OrganizationAddressKey], [CarrierCode] = [Carrier].[Code], [CarrierContractNumber] = [Consol].[CarrierContractNumber], [CarrierFullName] = [Carrier].[FullName], [CarrierID] = [Carrier].[OrganizationID], [CarrierOrganizationKey] = [Carrier].[OrganizationKey], [CoLoadCode] = [CoLoad].[Code], [CoLoadFullName] = [CoLoad].[FullName], [CoLoadOrganizationKey] = [CoLoad].[OrganizationKey], [ConsolidationID] = [Consol].[ConsolidationID], [ConsolidationKey] = [Consol].[ConsolidationKey], [CreditorAddressKey] = [CreditorAddress].[OrganizationAddressKey], [CreditorCode] = [Creditor].[Code], [CreditorID] = [Creditor].[OrganizationID], [CreditorOrganizationKey] = [Creditor].[OrganizationKey], [ReceivingAgentAddressKey] = [ReceivingAgentAddress].[OrganizationAddressKey], [ReceivingAgentCode] = [ReceivingAgent].[Code], [ReceivingAgentFullName] = [ReceivingAgent].[FullName], [ReceivingAgentID] = [ReceivingAgent].[OrganizationID], [ReceivingAgentOrganizationKey] = [ReceivingAgent].[OrganizationKey], [SendingAgentAddressKey] = [SendingAgentAddress].[OrganizationAddressKey], [SendingAgentCode] = [SendingAgent].[Code], [SendingAgentFullName] = [SendingAgent].[FullName], [SendingAgentID] = [SendingAgent].[OrganizationID], [SendingAgentOrganizationKey] = [SendingAgent].[OrganizationKey] FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__Consolidation Consol LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__OrganizationAddress AS CarrierAddress ON CarrierAddress.OrganizationAddressKey = Consol.CarrierAddressKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization AS Carrier ON Carrier.OrganizationKey = CarrierAddress.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__OrganizationAddress AS SendingAgentAddress ON SendingAgentAddress.OrganizationAddressKey = Consol.SendingAgentAddressKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization AS SendingAgent ON SendingAgent.OrganizationKey = SendingAgentAddress.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__OrganizationAddress AS ReceivingAgentAddress ON ReceivingAgentAddress.OrganizationAddressKey = Consol.ReceivingAgentAddressKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization AS ReceivingAgent ON ReceivingAgent.OrganizationKey = ReceivingAgentAddress.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__OrganizationAddress AS CreditorAddress ON CreditorAddress.OrganizationAddressKey = Consol.CreditorAddressKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization AS Creditor ON Creditor.OrganizationKey = CreditorAddress.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization AS CoLoad ON CoLoad.OrganizationKey = CreditorAddress.OrganizationKey AND Consol.ConsolidationType = 'CLD'
